page_title: ATM 0-1 BET | Atletico Madrid v Betis 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
90+3' 10:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
87' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Fidalgo will be replaced by Marc Bartra (Betis).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Antony walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
87' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
84' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
83' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
82' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
81' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
79' Substitution. Nelson Deossa (Betis) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cedric Bakambu walks off.
79' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
77' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Atl. Madrid due to an offside in the build-up play.
75' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Atl. Madrid players aren’t happy.

74' Diego Llorente (Betis) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends the ball into the top right corner of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
72' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
71' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
70' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Pablo Fornals and he is replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
70' Ademola Lookman comes off the pitch to be replaced by Obed Vargas (Atl. Madrid).
69' Half-chance! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Alvaro Valles reacts well to snuff out the attack.

67' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
67' Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
67' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
65' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
63' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets no option but to blow his whistle.
61' Betis take a short corner kick.
60' Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
60' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

60' What a great chance for Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
60' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
58' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) replacing Rodrigo Mendoza.
55' Marc Roca (Betis) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
52' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
51' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
51' The possession of the ball – 62:38.
47' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) comes off for Alexander Sorloth.
46' Diego Simeone has made a change at the break. Alex Baena has come on in place of Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Simeone probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Matteo Ruggeri. He is replaced by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid).
46' Referee Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
42' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Ademola Lookman, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
40' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
36' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

34' Koke (Atl. Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mateo Busquets with no other option than to blow for a foul. Betis are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
31' Flag goes up against Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' 0 - 1 Antony (Betis) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
28' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
22' Koke (Atl. Madrid) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
22' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). Atl. Madrid win a corner.
20' Total attempts – 7:3.
17' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
16' Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

16' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alvaro Valles pulls off a brilliant save.
15' The resulting corner from Pablo Fornals (Betis) is cleared by the defence.

15' Excellent touch by Cedric Bakambu (Betis)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.

12' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the roof of the net, but great anticipation by Jan Oblak allowed him to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
10' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
9' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Koke (Atl. Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

3' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
3' Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets will supervise the game today.
